{{Quote|Yeh, zhure I'll tell yuh, pal, yer the bezht pal a fella ever had ''(hic)''. The furball, he'zh at Margezh Base, yeah, that'sh the tick&hellip;''"<br />"''Can you tell me how to get to Margess Base?|A bounty hunter and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="RPG" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''bounty hunter''' was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] once extracted information out of the hunter by getting him drunk on [[Corellian whiskey/Legends|Corellian whiskey]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] revealed that an individual he referred to as a "furball" was being held at [[Margess Base]].<ref name="RPG" />
